notes:
## What's new
- **Copy a file's full path** — Properties now has a Path row with the full location and file name; tap it to copy the path to the clipboard
- **Classic look: new selection menu** — long-press selects files, and all selection actions (Select all/none, Open with, Rename, Properties, Copy, Cut, Extract, Copy to/Move to, Share, Compress, Convert, Delete) are in the ☰ menu in the toolbar, so the file list keeps its full size while selecting

## Improved
- On Android 13 and newer, copying a path shows only Android's own clipboard preview instead of an extra message
